commonProcedure:
Use only the exact native classAccess row and a real acquired casting profile; sufficient RP or class level alone is not acquisition. The five root spells are rank9/base26/class17. Preserve all native rows and Core cards in completeSourceAndAccess. Four roots use Action/V,S,F; Ritual Mastery uses ten minutes/V,S,M/F. The focus alternative supplies no otherwise required target/substrate. Root120feet metadata is retained: Perfect/World are caster-origin authorizations with payload targets satisfying BOTH the root120-foot anchor limit and the payload's own actual geometry; this is NEW local completion, not teleporting an origin. Perfection/Ascendance are NEW Self benefits;120feet does not grant ally transfer. Mastery targets a real ritual/leader within120feet and line of effect throughout work.
Preflight actual body/voice/usable hand/focus, permitted action, known restrictions, range/line, targets and current quote. Reject known illegality before any expenditure; hidden/intervening failure after commitment spends the costs, reveals no hidden reason, supplies no substitute, and restores no previous concentration. Freeze identities, mode, payload graph, price-source versions and selected optional amounts. Commit once: Action (or start long work), RP and other charges, source-specific finite uses, prospective concentration transition, actual class protected cadence, Refrain and beginning hooks. Then open the one actual cast-interruption window. A counter pays its own costs/history; a resumed parent never overwrites that later history. Spell rank for a root interrupt is9: DC28 for the actual Wizard Counterspell card (rank1,3RP,Reaction,60feet,recharge2), using INT+PB and Core task degrees/natural shifts. Root rejection isn't a counter, and immunity to damage is not a casting permission.
NEW local invocation graph for Perfect/World/Mastery: an explicit finite directed path/tree of source IDs, with every wrapper selection and one terminal spell or ritual action named before commitment. Reject a repeated wrapper identity on one ancestor path before paying; a distinct useful nesting is legal. Do not ban rank9 payloads or count an Action, echo, reordered initiative or pulse as a new turn. Each real paid spell cast has one history/root; embedded invocation nodes are not extra Actions/casts/refund generators. Preserve payload provenance for each actual damage, healing, payment, recovery, condition and custody event. Hooks inspect their exact predicate once: actual cast, actual amount paid, successful resolution, actual damage or actual recovery are distinct. No universal anti-proc rule removes an independently satisfied source trigger. One wrapper never grants an unacquired passive class engine, item, soul, body or reaction opportunity.
Use source-specific clocks. A minute here is60 elapsed seconds from manifestation, never from each target's next turn. Each actor keeps its own regular starts/ends, budget refresh/spend, recharge ticks and Ready expiry. Idle regular turns can vent1 Dissonance only under the actual class rule; continuing magical work is not idle. Starting a root at a regular phase does not reset that phase. On death, concentration and these temporary Self benefits end; revival does not renew them. Suppression blocks only its actual scope, preserves original deadlines, causes no automatic recast, and never refunds prior payment. Actual removal requires a real acquired dispel, real rank/check/range/perception and spend; no Greater Dispel is assumed. Missing external suppression/Null/copy source facts keep that branch held, not a fabricated positive event.
Ordinary Ready uses one real Action spell cast at preparation, full payment/components/cadence/countering and held concentration, expiring at the next own regular START. A real perceived trigger and Reaction release it without a second payment/casting history; target/range revalidate at release and an effect's duration begins there. Ten-minute work cannot be ordinary Readied. The already-accepted seven-profile copied-feat Ready preparation-only allowance is preserved without extending it to these rank9 spells: no positive copied branch exists unless the exact copy source permits that rank/identity. Serialization preserves every clock, source root, resource receipt, acquisition/custody record and pending decision; loading is no in-world action or clock reset.

newChoices: All clauses marked NEW and all local completions above are proposed spell-local authorship, not global authority.
procedure:
Select exactly one spell that this same continuing identity genuinely knew earlier. Retain an immutable acquisition event with exact spell/mode, source class/school/rank, acquisition permission, level and timestamp, plus present access and memory status. Ordinary learned/book spells later unprepared, book-lost, forgotten or lost-class can qualify; current casting ability still comes from the real World Rewrite class, not a fabricated lost class level. Mere witnessing, notes, captured/copied effect, borrowed-use permission or equipment ownership is not knowledge.
NEW WR194-COMMUNION: the exact accepted Resonance Communion grant truly temporarily knows AND prepares three actual class-qualified reviewed spells, so a grant actually resolved creates historical ever-known evidence. Its later expiry removes current slots, not that historical fact. World Rewrite, not Communion itself, supplies the new recast. No permanent book formula, teaching credential or fourth learned slot is created. Bind all three original selected IDs and actual grant event. No use of a pending comparison as an acquired feature.
NEW WR194-CAST: root26RP replaces the selected spell's normal baseRP (do not pay both bases); preserve its mandatory extras/surcharges, HP sacrifice, consumed materials, charges/finite permissions, actual components, continuing concentration, source prerequisites and ordinary target geometry. RootAction is the minimum initiation cost; native Action/BonusAction payload executes in that action, a Reaction payload still needs its real trigger, and a longer cast retains its complete work duration/concentration/each required Action unless an actual Perfect ancestor waived that time. RootV/S/F and any additional native payload requirement both apply. No universal instant long-cast or cost-free effect follows from the word recast.
Counts as9 means the actual recast's interrupt, suppression/removal rank tests and ranked strain use9; it does not add dice, target count, duration, or level-scaling absent an explicit payload scaling source. Keep the terminal spell's school for actual school prohibitions and school-specific current casting-stat bonus. A current Seal Magic on that payload school blocks the cast; a Universal wrapper cannot launder it. Missing present memory is not automatically a loss of the immutable acquisition fact, but a real broad prohibition on casting/retrieving the necessary payload remains effective. Exact unspecified memory-erasure interactions remain CC194-H04, never evidence of a successful bypass.
Freeze the terminal identity and retained costs at declaration. Validate known/currently effective restrictions before payment; hidden later loss before completion gives no replacement or refund. One root cast/history and payload outcome, actual counter before effects, actual damage/concentration and provenance after. No world/history rewrite or return of spent gear/HP/RP occurs. Keep useful distinct wrapper nesting under the finite graph rule; if the selected historically known spell is Perfect, its own broad payload choice is available but its unresolved funded-output branch remains held, not silently accepted through this identity.
NEW WR194-class-mode completion: a genuinely acquired always-prepared class spell is historical knowledge of that exact class mode, not access to unrelated features. A recast of the actor's own acquired Wizard Counterspell keeps its recharge2 and shared per-pending-cast attempt constraint; base3 is replaced by root26. Its genuine successful counter satisfies the actor's acquired Arcane Feedback once/round. This is an actual new recast, not a captured/copied/companion/reflected Counterspell, and supplies no second root cast or class history update.
qualifications: Static authored review only; no canonical application or runtime selection.
No runtime execution, implementation certification, human-play/playtest, balance, cosmology, domain-closure, whole-game completion or release approval.

Actual campaign acquisition, bodies, matter, equipment, targets, geometry, custodians and information require their own evidence. Fixture premises are conditional operands, never authenticated campaign facts.
Exact current applied index selects accepted comparison scope. Later source edits and historical proposal labels are not independent acceptance.
No newly authored spell-local choice is a global rule, permission to reopen a completed cohort, or permission to change the canonical index/catalog/queue/handoff.
